title: REQ · Escape, focus trap and focus restore are asserted for the dialog
summary: Close button gets a test id and keyboard tests prove Escape, trap and restore
description: Context: Radix Dialog supplies Escape and focus trap; onCloseAutoFocus restores focus to returnFocusRef. Desired behavior: Close button has a test id; tests assert the three behaviours directly on ContributionSheet. Why: SG-8.5 keyboard coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Given an open sheet, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once
Given a button outside the dialog, when it is focused while the sheet is open, then focus returns inside the dialog
Given returnFocusRef points at a trigger, when the sheet closes, then the trigger has focus
